description:
Clash Meta (Mihomo) desktop client with TUN and system-proxy modes

Sloth Clash is a desktop client for the Mihomo (Clash Meta) proxy core. Import a
subscription or a share link, pick a node, and route traffic either through the system
proxy or through a TUN adapter that captures every application. Rules, proxy groups,
connections and logs are editable and inspectable in place. The app ships its own pinned
core and a small privileged helper service for TUN mode, updates subscriptions in the
background, verifies its own updates with signed checksums, and can rewrite the generated
configuration with a per-profile JavaScript hook for the cases the editors do not cover.
